programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: mareTV: In Alaska's Fjord World
programme.desc: Gigantic fjords and over 5,000 small islands: In Alaska's south there's a lot of wilderness and little civilization. The region between the capital Juneau and the Canadian border is also known by locals as the "Last Frontier", the last outpost. Michelle Masden, for example, has come to terms with the harsh conditions here. She is the only seaplane pilot in the region. She earns her living with her 65-year-old Beaver: as an air taxi, transport plane and now and then as a rescuer in last necessity. Michelle flies anything and everything: spare parts and food, doctors, hikers and hunters. For the fishermen of southern Alaska she searches for large shoals of fish and guides the captains to the next good catch. Ray Rusaw was a car mechanic by profession, but in his old age he was gripped by gold fever. With a self-built special raft and a highly creative selection of equipment from the DIY store, he sets off in search of the precious metal that his predecessors overlooked two centuries ago. For four years he has been happily obsessively combing through sandbanks and river courses. For Ray, the search for gold has little to do with luck and much to do with meticulous research. He is certain that he has found the perfect spot.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: The Green Heart of Croatia - At the Banks of River Sava
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Wild River Rhine
programme.desc: Alluvial forests, roaring waterfalls, steep canyons and sunny slopes flank the river Rhine. The variety of habitats is the reason for the large biodiversity along the stream.There is hardly any other river in Germany that is surrounded by as many myths and legends as the river Rhine. No other river has been the topic of songs, has been painted and travelled equally frequently. Despite this it still seems to be true today what the French poet Victor Hugo once said about this river – the Rhine is a river everybody talks about, nobody explores, everybody visits but no one really knows. The film follows the water against the stream. It starts at the river’s delta in the Netherlands, flows through six countries and ends in the Swiss Alps.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.sub-title: The Psychogramm of a Spiritual Landscape
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Gates of the Arctic
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: mareTV: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV: Wismar Bay - World Heritage and Water Paradise
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. Even after his shift is over, he is looking for the thrill: the wind off his home island of Poel is favorable that day and he wants to reclaim the German record in the kite surfing high jump. For a long time, Ramona Stelzer only knew fish as a tasty ingredient between two halves of a bun. But when the goldsmith got her hands on fish leather, her business idea was born: she processes the unique natural product fish skin into fine jewelry. The problem is that hardly anyone in Germany tans fish skin. In order to reliably obtain supplies, Ramona now wants to learn this craft herself.

programme.title: mareTV: Wismar Bay - World Heritage and Water Paradise
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and vitality, is but one measure put in place to secure the preservation of the natural gem. Time-lapse photography and breath-taking shots show our main protagonist – the woods – in its stunning glory. This beautiful wooded land, changes throughout the seasons. Our woodland is a world-renowned ecological jewel. It is famous, well-known and loved by tourists, forest economists, environmentalists, historians and intellectuals alike.

programme.title: Germany's Mystic Forest
programme.desc: 2.000 rivers and streams dig deep into the underground and transport their water into reservoirs or "Germany's Wild Amazon", the Wupper. These forests and rivers, together with heathlands and moors, are home to a diverse fauna. Martens, badgers, wild boars, hares, roe deer, and red deer, even black grouse and hazel deer find shelter in these parts. Wolves also have a dominant presence, not to mention those who live underground, such as lizards, bats, and snakes. Accompany us on a journey where we explore every corner of this rugged land. Climb underground into the Bergisches Land, through the vast hidden cave systems that sprawl far beneath the forests. There is also much to be discovered in the water, dive with us in crystal clear streams and rivers with their diverse flora and fauna.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In the Alps
programme.desc: Secluded for many centuries in inaccessible valleys, the inhabitants of the Alps had no alternative but to rely on the healing powers of nature. A knowledge of herbs was deeply rooted in these mountain-dwellers’ everyday lives – until the twentieth century, when this wisdom became eclipsed by modern academic medicine. Today, Alpine herbs are witnessing a revival, as public interest in regional natural treasures grows. The potential of Alpine herbs is far from exhausted. In the Berchtesgaden Alps, the film shows Hubsi Ilsanker at work as a root-digger, a back-breaking job that has scarcely changed in four hundred years. Authorized by a special historic permit to supply the oldest gentian distillery in Germany, Hubsi digs for protected gentian roots in Berchtesgaden National Park. For yellow gentian is one of the most bitter medicinal herbs in the world, well suited for schnapps and as a general tonic.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret world of Herbs - In the Balkans
programme.desc: In the pristine nature and mild climate of southeastern Europe grows a unique diversity of wild plants. Far removed from major industry and polluted soils, the Balkan countries have become the largest exporter of herbs in Europe. In Bulgaria alone, more than 300,000 people work with domestic plants. The business is becoming increasingly lucrative. The film takes us to the Croatian coast. On the Adriatic island of Cres, the audience meets Mladen Dragoslavić. In May, when the sage begins to blossom, this beekeeper has one month to produce his income for an entire year – always with the goal of creating the best sage honey in the Balkans. Given a choice, the bees would never choose sage, for entering and exiting the narrow blossom is strenuous. Within three weeks, maximum, Mladen must remove his bees from the island. Otherwise they will die of exhaustion. In Skopje, the capital of Macedonia, the film visits Iva Yosifova. Hollyhock provides the raw material for her objects of art. The herb is medically beneficial, due to its mucilage, which is added to many cough tea mixtures. Iva, though, makes paper from hollyhock. Thanks to the herb’s long fibres, the paper can be spread onto objects and modeled. The technique produces delicate sculptures, as fragile as nature.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Europe's Wild River - The Elbe - 1.000 Miles of Wildlife and Nature
programme.desc: The river rises in the Czech Giant Mountains. Here it is called the Labe. After Děčín it flows into Germany and is called Elbe. There are various explanations for the origin of the river name "Elbe". One often mentioned is the Latin name of the river "albia", which means "bright water". This would also explain why the stream is referred to with the feminine article "the Elbe", since the Latin term "albia" is also feminine. Rather poetic than linguistically probable, however, is the explanation that elves (Middle High German: alb) scurrying around the pines in the white river mists could have helped the river to get its name. Geographically, the river can be divided into different sections: The Upper Elbe is the part from the source to about Riesa in the administrative district of Dresden, which is more characterized by mountains. The Middle Elbe, on the other hand, is a lowland river. It reaches as far as the Geesthacht dam just outside Hamburg. The Lower Elbe is called the tidal part of the river. Here, the Elbe forms an estuary, a so-called estuary. At high tide, seawater enters this funnel-shaped delta at the mouth of the Elbe and mixes with the freshwater of the river. At low tide, the water then flows off to the North Sea. Finally, the continuation of the estuary funnel in the Wadden Sea is called the Outer Elbe.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.desc: no info available

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
programme.desc: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sin City Shootout

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The top three girls take a cable car to Sugar Loaf Mountain to learn Samba dancing.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Aptitude and Natural Talent
programme.desc: All 14 girls are interviewed by the press where they are asked why they want to win. The models pair up and pick each partners best and worst features. The girls receive news about their first photoshoot and later find out it's a topless shoot in pairs.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Poise and Composure
programme.desc: The girls get a crash course in dance with top choreographer Supple and a runway lesson from top fashionista Jeanette. The winners get to take part in a fashion show featuring the work of top designer Scottee - whose dresses are all made out of paper.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Style and Presentation
programme.desc: The girls find out they're getting makeovers in a Lisa Mail. This weeks challenge is a bucking bronco advertisement for the cheesy "Britain's Next Top Model Hairspray". In this weeks photoshoot they have the added element of working with a small dog.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Character and Personality
programme.desc: The girls took part in a challenge for Jai Kudo glasses. At the photoshoot the models are greeted by Gerry Deveaux and Giorgio Guidotti, of Italian fashion house, Primarni for a shoot for the latest collection by SportMax one of Max Mara's labels.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Exhibition and Spectacle
programme.desc: The girls meet with TV star, June Sarpong to learn interview skills and are judged by undercover magazine journalists. The claws are out as the girls critique each other during the challenge. Tension in the house builds.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Drama and Performance
programme.desc: This week the girls learn some new choreography with Supple and in the photoshoot the girls are told they are to pose for an album cover. Lisa Snowdon treats everyone to cocktails with The Bar Wizards -finalists on last years Britain's Got Talent.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Intelligence and Originality
programme.desc: The models face an acting challenge which includes a steamy kissing scene with guest actor Guy Burnet. The photoshoot this week is a couture shot where each girl had to portray a different emotion.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Imagination and Creativity
programme.desc: The girls pose as different types of mannequines for their photoshoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Stamina and Endurance
programme.desc: The girls are put through a series of circus acts and asked to model on plinths in London's streets. The girls also pose for beauty shots in Zandra Rhodes dresses in the style of sporting events.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Beauty and Cover Girl
programme.desc: The girls start the week by attending a casting session with Sadie Frost and Jemima French. They meet up with Caroline Barnes and Sophie Beresiner for a beauty editorial and the photoshoot is for the cover of Company Magazine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Semi-Finals
programme.desc: In the penulimate episode of Cycle 4, the girls arive in South Africa and they participate in an African themed photoshoot. In the end one girl is sent home to the UK.

programme.desc: När Ninas låtsaskompis blir levande, hamnar Kanicula på kollisionskurs med en övernaturlig varelse vars like han aldrig har mött förut.

programme.title: Kanicula: Ett juiceproblem
programme.desc: Efter att Chester ger Kanicula olika grönsaksjuicer så han kan städa huset blir resultatet så bra att katten fortsätter att hälla juice i kaninen.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Fena på biljard
programme.desc: Titans uppmuntrar Hajkungen att börja spela biljard igen, men han måste först lära sig att lita på sin magkänsla.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Livet med linne
programme.desc: Hajkungen bär ett linne och lär Titans allt om "linne-livet".

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: En blöt historia
programme.desc: Titans har en skön dag vid sjön, men när Robin blir förälskad i en fisk tvingas han välja mellan henne och Titans.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Megalodon Jackson
programme.desc: Titans ställs mot en gigantisk haj men upptäcker snart att saker och ting inte är vad de verkar vara.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Utomhus
programme.desc: Familjen Watterson förvandlar sitt hus till ett fängelse.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Härmaporna
programme.desc: Familjen Watterson upptäcker en familj med tecknade härmapor som imiterar allt de gör.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Havskatten
programme.desc: Farfar Louie får en ny onlinevän, det enda problemet är att hon inte finns på riktigt.

programme.title: Gumballs härligt helgalna värld: Tråkigheten
programme.desc: Gumball och Darwin använder Mollys förmåga att stoppa tiden (för att hon är så tråkig) för att undvika att få en omgång stryk av Tina efter skolan.

programme.title: Kanicula: Kaniculemoji
programme.desc: Kanicula förvandlas till sin egen emoji när han ska försöka fånga en flörtande hjärt-emoji som har infiltrerat Nina och Scotts textmeddelanden.

programme.title: Kanicula: Pepparkaksmarodören
programme.desc: Chester och Kanicula hamnar i en färgglad värld av godis och marshmallows där Harald är kung.

programme.title: Kanicula: Lafittes medaljong
programme.desc: Ett gäng pirater hittar en medaljong som kan visa framtiden. Och de tänker ändra den med lite hjälp från en övernaturlig kanin som heter Kanicula.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Bevingad kärlek
programme.desc: Beemo hjälper två pirriga insekter med kärleken, men när Finn och Jake lägger sig i flörtförsöken hotas krypens spirande ungdomskärlek.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Lite håla får man tåla
programme.desc: Finn tar med Jake till sin barndoms älskade fängelsehåla. När den visar sig ha förändrats, försöker Jake återskapa den besvikna Finns glada minnen.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Segerraden: Del ett
programme.desc: Det är brottssäsong och Robin är bestämd att fortsätta sin rad av att stoppa 52 brott per år.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Vinstraden: Del två
programme.desc: Robins rad av 52 stoppade brott per år hotas när medlemmar ur hans gäng fångar av Blixtpojken.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Titanerna räddar tiden
programme.desc: Titanerna bestämmer sig för att ta reda på vad som händer med den saknade timman under sommartiden.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Kärleken
programme.desc: När Bobert upptäcker att han har fått ett virus med namnet kärlek.exe ber han Gumball och Darwin att definiera ordet kärlek.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Pinsamheten
programme.desc: Gumball är så upptagen med att sjunga om ketchup att han ej märker att han nästan krockar med varmkorvkillen. De märker dock att de går åt samma håll.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Nästet
programme.desc: Familjen Watersson ser på nyheterna att deras granne försvunnit. När de söker ledtrådar hittar de ett märkligt ägg som tillhör deras elaka sköldpadda.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Poängen
programme.desc: Gumball och Darwin upptäcker att det går mycket bättre för Tobias än för dom själva i ett online spelet Galaktrek.

programme.title: Gumballs härligt helgalna värld: Trafik
programme.desc: Familjen Watterson måste ta Anais till Daisyland innan parken av säkerhetsskäl stänger för gott, men de möter ständiga hinder på vägen dit.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Hårda bandage / Telefonstolpeskoj 2: Krympande telefonstolpe / Full fart neråt
programme.desc: Daffy inser att han är en bedrövlig skräddare. Friska fläktar med Sylveser. Gråbens nya apparat kan bygga vägar, men kan den fixa middagen?

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Känslomässig stöd-anka / Där kopplet slutar: Tennis / Adoptera mig!
programme.desc: Pelle låtdsas att dffy är en emotionell stödanka. Ture splar en smärtsam tennismatch. Charlie Hund visar alla att han är tidernas bästa hund.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Inkräktande fordon / Bland blommor och bin / Slaget om kanalen
programme.desc: Marvin från Mars är en lätt match för NASA:s Marsbil. Taz lär sig om bin.. På det jobbiga viset. Pelle och Daffy blir osams om radiokanaler.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Skallben / Slappna av
programme.desc: En hund får problem när han gräver ner ett ben i Snurre Sprätts hål. Pelle Gris vill koppla av, men hans brorson Cidero är på besök.

programme.title: Clarence: Renässansmarknad
programme.desc: Clarence och hans kompisar åker till en medeltidsmarknad. Clarence tror att en pjäs är på riktigt och lovar att rädda prinsessan från riddaren.

programme.title: Clarence: Tidsbrott
programme.desc: När Clarence tror att han kan manipulera tiden svär han att bara använda sin förmåga i godhetens namn. Hans övertygelse sätts på prov en dag i skolan.

programme.title: Clarence: Lördagsskola
programme.desc: Efter att ha skapat en väggmålning utan tillåtelse på skolan tvingas Clarence, Jeff och Sumo komma till skolan en lördag för att städa som straff.

programme.title: Clarence: Attack mot kvartersfesten
programme.desc: Clarence, Jeff och Sumo undersöker en gymnasie-fest i deras kvarter, och de tror att det är en invasion från rymden.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Godisanden
programme.desc: När Finn och Jake skrämmer en mytisk varelse, utlöser de Godisragnarök. Nu måste vännerna skynda sig om de ska hinna rädda riket från undergång.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Spelkväll
programme.desc: Fröken Regnhörning är spelledare när prinsessan Bubbelgum, Marceline och Klumprymdprinsessan ger sig ut på ett episkt DoD-äventyr.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Valpen
programme.desc: Barnen får äntligen en hundvalp, vilket de alltid velat, men det är egentligen en sköldpadda, och den hatar dem.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Kopian
programme.desc: Gumball och Darwin kommer på hemligheten bakom Antons odödlighet.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Statisterna
programme.desc: Gumball och Darwin har en lugn dag och de andra karaktärerna får äntligen en chans att synas.

programme.title: Kanicula: Mumkey Business
programme.desc: Efter att Chester har fått nog av Kaniculas övernaturliga galenskaper bestämmer han sig för att låsa in kaninen i kryptan där han hittades.

programme.title: Kanicula: Fiskben
programme.desc: När ett magiskt munspel drar till sig zombiefiskar och hotar Orlocks hyreshus måste Kanicula hindra dem från att skrämma Nina.

programme.title: Kanicula: Spindellamm
programme.desc: När Harald kommer hem efter en operation gör Chester och Kanicula allt de kan för att deras vän ska få vila ut och läser en godnattsaga för honom.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Prat i kvadrat
programme.desc: Titans är redo att koppla av efter att ha besegrat alla skurkar i Hoppstaden, men blir förvånade när de upptäcker att det fortfarande finns en kvar.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Fiske!!!
programme.desc: Robin måste lära sig sportanimens knep för att besegra en rivaliserande fiskare.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Linjaler äger
programme.desc: Robin lär Titans hur man använder en linjal.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Elseworlds
programme.desc: När Titans förvisas till Elseworlds, försöker de hitta en väg tillbaka till DC:s huvudtidslinje.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Fula ord
programme.desc: När Jake berättar att han grävt ner fula demonord i trädgården, måste Finn övertyga honom om att möta sina inre demoner – bokstavligt talat!

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Räddningsprinsessan
programme.desc: Finn och Jake måste stoppa Iskungen i hans jakt på en verklighetsfrånvänd ensidig kärlek med prinsessan som räddade honom.

programme.title: Gumballs härligt helgalna värld: Bestraffningen
programme.desc: Gumball och Nicole blir försenade till ett viktigt möte på skolan och svär att hämnas på föraren till den bil som sinkade deras frenetiska framfart.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Hjärnan!
programme.desc: Familjen måste sluta göra dumma saker eftersom Anais slår sig för pannan varje gång det händer.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Föräldrarna
programme.desc: Nicole återknyter med sina föräldrar

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Grundaren
programme.desc: Pappa skapar kaos i Chanax byggnaden när han misstas för vara den sedan länge försvunne VDn.

programme.title: Regular Show: De försvunna videobanden: Ett hett minne
programme.desc: En bra kycklingvingefest kräver en stark sås.

programme.title: Regular Show: De försvunna videobanden: Hemlig menyrätt
programme.desc: Vem älskar inte en hemlig menyrätt?

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Prat i kvadrat
programme.desc: Titans är redo att koppla av efter att ha besegrat alla skurkar i Hoppstaden, men blir förvånade när de upptäcker att det fortfarande finns en kvar.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Plågoandar
programme.desc: När Titans hindrar en stöld mot ett museum, stöter de på Pissa Goblin, som skickar Titans egna plågoandar på dem.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Justice Leagues Nästa Topptalang Idolstjärna: Dansupplagan
programme.desc: Det är dags för ännu en Justice League talangjakt och Vibe ansluter sig till domarpanelen för att bedöma DC universumets dansgruppers alla danssteg.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Profetian
programme.desc: Finn och Jake möter en figur som kallar sig kungen av Ooo, och de två vännerna luras att tro att de är efterlängtade hjältar i en gammal alvlegend.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Bilstrid
programme.desc: Finn och Jake hittar en gokart utan motor. Jake förvandlar sig då till motor och pressas till det yttersta i ett lopp mot en retsam rövare.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Seg kärlek
programme.desc: Finn och Jake ska hitta en partner åt en snigel som hotar att stjäla deras hem.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Energidjuret
programme.desc: Ta tag i din vän, vi åker till ett avlägset land. Med hunden Jake och människan Finn, dom har så roligt jämt.

programme.title: Regular Show: Här kommer siaren
programme.desc: Gänget behöver prata med någon som är smart.

programme.title: Regular Show: Upp med hakan, Pops
programme.desc: Gänget vill muntra upp Pops.

programme.title: Regular Show: En vanlig episk slutstrid, Del 1
programme.desc: En episk slutstrid börjar.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Skallen
programme.desc: Pojkarna blir vänner med en tvångsmässig lögnare, men lögnerna fortsätter att orsaka problem…

programme.title: Kapinalliset
programme.desc: Jack on 25-vuotias. Kavereineen hän polttaa, juopottelee ja iskee tyttöjä Tukholmassa. Toisin kun moni muu, Jack tietää mitä hänestä tulee isona: kirjailija. Hänen jengissään pyörii Bart, joka haluaa taiteilijaksi sekä Harald, joka myy huumeita. He seurustelevat valokuvaaja-Jonnyn ja tämän tyttöystävän Linnean kanssa. Yhdessä he kokevat iloa ja surua, pohtivat elämää ja matkustavat Gotlantiin polkupyöräilemään.

programme.title: Miffo

programme.title: Saariston lapsille tapahtuu
programme.desc: Astrid Lingrenin tarinaan perustuva lasten elokuva. Melker-setä ei epäröi hetkeäkään kun Pelle pyytää häntä leikkimään - koko päiväksi. Saariston lasten poppoo lähtee leikkimään lahdenpoukamaan vanhalle laivalle. Melker-setä jakaa heidät kahteen ryhmään, ja niin ’Hait’ ja ’Haukat’ ryhtyvät merirosvosotaan!

programme.title: Saariston lasten suuri seikkailu
programme.desc: Pikku Ninni haaksirikkoutuu autiolle saarelle yhdessä Pampulan, Pellen ja Stinan kanssa. Oikeastaan heidän ei ollut tarkoitus kuin käydä saarella, mutta Ninni ei olekaan aivan niin hyvä köyttämään veneitä rantaan kuin luuli! Saarella majailee myös kaksi salakuljettajaa, joiden veneen Ninni myöskin sitoi lujasti kiinni...

programme.title: Padelunelmia
programme.desc: Sarja alkaa. Fabian ja Hasse pyörittävät elämäänsä kyllästyneinä sulkkishallia unisessa pikkukaupungissa. Uusi idea voi muuttaa kaiken - padel! Ruotsalainen komediasarja Fabianista ja Hassesta, jotka päättävät muuttaa sulkkishallinsa padelhalliksi. Vaikkei heillä ole hajuakaan koko hommasta, he satsaavat projektiin lapsen innolla ja täynnä tulevaisuudenuskoa. Ruotsi 2023

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Onko Berndt dementoitunut?. Ruth päättää tutustua isoisäänsä paremmin. Klara ja Tomas ovat huolissaan Berndtin kalkkiutumisesta. Rille joutuu riitaan lastenkasvatuksesta. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Solsidan - onnea onkimassa
programme.desc: Merille. Alex on saanut venepaikan, mutta hänellä ei ole venettä, joten miespolo joutuu ryhtymään vaaralliseen hankkeeseen Sundbergien kanssa. Anna auttaa Runea uuden puhelimen käyttöönotossa, mutta joutuu pian keskelle karmeaa tekstiviestikiristysdraamaa. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: John muuttaa vastaanotolle. Avan on yhä vaikeampi vastustaa tunteitaan, ja hän ryhtyy rajuihin toimiin päästäkseen Johnista eroon. Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Pidätä henkeä!
programme.desc: Kummitusyö #creepy. Jokin on vallannut saaren - kummitukset vai avaruusoliot? Ystävämme pakenevat ja yrittävät käsitellä pelkojaan. Ehtivätkö he ilmaista tunteensa? Ruotsalaisessa nuorisosarjassa seuraamme kolmea teiniä, jotka tulevat aivan eri maailmoista ja tapaavat tapahtumarikkaalla kesäleirillä. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Agatha Christien Hjerson
programme.desc: Pahoinpidelty mies kanapuvussa katoaa rannalta. Klara tulee auttamaan, löytääkseen samalla ehkä skuupin. Hjersonin vanhat muistot heräävät eloon. Moderni ruotsalainen arvoitusdekkari, jonka innoittajina olivat Agatha Christien kertomukset. Ainutlaatuinen murhatutkija Sven Hjerson (Johan Rheborg) muodostaa yllättävän etsiväkaksikon omapäisen tv-tuottajan (Hanna Alström) kanssa. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Sarja alkaa. Koska Thomasin ja Klaran äiti on juuri kuollut, he lähtevät isänsä takia kesäksi perheen kesäpaikkaan. Thomas tuo mukaan uuden naisensa. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2015

programme.title: Happy fucking Pride
programme.desc: "Shock and Awe". Dilan keksii tavan tehdä vaikutuksen Christophiin, mutta se on riskialtis ja vaarantaa Arin uran. Nina törmää Ziggyyn, ja Ari yrittää unohtaa Jonasin. Tukholma kuplii odotuksia Pride-viikon alkaessa. Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Saga täyttää vuosia ja juhlii kunnolla. Jennyn ex-poikaystävä Sebbe ilmestyy paikalle ja aiheuttaa välikohtauksen. Jenny tuntee olonsa ulkopuoliseksi. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Totte Svensson ja nuoruuden lähteen metsästys
programme.desc: Kausi päättyy. Kärppä aikoo iskeä maailman johtajien kimppuun. Vain sankarimme voivat pysäyttää hänet, mutta aika on vähissä ja ennuste huono. Mestarietsivä Totte Svensson saa yhteydenoton sisaruksilta, joiden vanhemmat on siepattu. Voiko Jeppe Kärppä olla taas vauhdissa? 2023

programme.title: Karkurit
programme.desc: Old School. Karkuri on vanhan koulukunnan herrasmiesrikollinen, jonka impulsiivisuus aiheuttaa ongelmia. Tiimin konkari Pertti ei jaa kaikkia tietojaan Karitalle, joka kipuilee kadonneen tiimijäsenen takia. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Karkurit
programme.desc: Ghost. Karkuri on kummituksen tavoin liikkuva palkkamurhaaja, joka on yksikön perässä. Tiimin nuorin jäsen Lori joutuu näytönpaikkaan. Pertti lähtee Ruotsiin selvittämään kadonneen tiimiläisen mysteeriä. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Metsästäjät
programme.desc: Särnin ja Peterin konflikti kärjistyy. Peter saa tietää järkyttävän totuuden Lizasta. Erik tajuaa olleensa sokea. Ruotsalainen jännitysdraama, jossa Rolf Lassgård esittää omapäistä poliisia Erik Bäckströmiä. Sarja on jatkoa samannimiselle elokuvasarjalle. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: We Come in Peace
programme.desc: Pelasta minut. Zandra ja Kasper muuttavat Eliasin luo. Petra yrittää ajaa omaa etuaan, mutta Moa haluaa koko maailman hyötyvän munasta. Adam ja Tobbe lyöttäytyvät yksiin ihailemansa tubettajan kanssa. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Bäckström
programme.desc: Kausi alkaa. Bäckström on ensimmäisenä paikalla julkkisasianajaja Erikssonin murhan jälkeen. Poliisi ei voi sulkea pois arkkivihollisen syyllisyyttä. Ruotsalainen rikosdraama perustuu Leif G.W. Perssonin suosittuihin kirjoihin ristiriitaisesta ja omahyväisestä murhatutkijasta Evert Bäckströmistä, joka ratkoo rikoksia omintakeisella tyylillään. Ruotsi 2020

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Sarjamurhaajakoomikko Dylan Myles suunnittelee uusia murhia, ja rikoskumppaninaan hänellä on oma vatsastapuhumisnukkensa. Bexin tiimillä on kiire ymmärtää miehen tavoitteet, ennen kuin lisää verta vuodatetaan. Yhdysvallat 2025

programme.title: All Eyez on Me
programme.desc: Artisti Tupac Shakur syntyi New Yorkissa Black Panther -liikkeen jäsenen poikana ja kasvoi Baltimoressa, missä hän otti ensimmäiset askeleet uskomattomalla uralla, jolla hän lopulta myi 75 miljoonaa levyä. Hän oli myös suuntaa-antava hahmo itä- ja länsirannikon hip hop -piirien sanasodassa.

programme.desc: Katto-Kassinen on kaunis, ihmeen viisas ja sopivan lihava mies parhaassa iässä. Eräänä päivänä hän lentää Pikkuveljen luokse ja heistä tulee ystäviä.

programme.title: Kidz in da Hood
programme.desc: Musiikkipitoinen koko perheen elokuva Aminasta, joka on odottanut kolme vuotta oleskelulupaansa. Kun hänen isoisänsä kuolee, kaikki menee sekaisin.

programme.title: Padelunelmia
programme.desc: Hassella ja Fabianilla on eri näkemykset padelhallin käynnistämisestä, mikä näkyy selvästi radiohaastattelussa. Uhkaava padelkuningas tulee käymään. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Fabianista ja Hassesta, jotka päättävät muuttaa sulkkishallinsa padelhalliksi. Vaikkei heillä ole hajuakaan koko hommasta, he satsaavat projektiin lapsen innolla ja täynnä tulevaisuudenuskoa. Ruotsi 2023

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Ruthin kaverit. Lily innostuu näennäistieteellisestä kirjasta ja järjestää työpajan. Ruthin uusi polyamorinen kaverikolmikko saa aikaan kulttuurien yhteentörmäyksen. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Solsidan - onnea onkimassa
programme.desc: Illallinen. Mickan on voittanut Tareq Taylorin valmistaman illallisen, ja Fredde saa apukokin roolin. Anna on kutsunut ruokaseurakseen hipsterin… vai onko kyseessä sittenkin koditon luuseri? Juuri kun luksusaterian on määrä alkaa, Alexin aineenvaihdunta hiipuu. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: Avan mielestä suhde Johniin etenee liian nopeasti, ja hän haluaa ottaa askeleen takaisin. Markus antaa Johnille hyvää tarkoittavia neuvoja. Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Pidätä henkeä!
programme.desc: Kenestä pidät eniten?. Kummitusyö jatkuu, mutta nyt uhka alkaa selvitä - ohjaajat tietenkin. Muitakin paljastuksia tehdään. Kuka paljastuu pahiten, ennen kuin yö on ohi? Ruotsalaisessa nuorisosarjassa seuraamme kolmea teiniä, jotka tulevat aivan eri maailmoista ja tapaavat tapahtumarikkaalla kesäleirillä. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Agatha Christien Hjerson
programme.desc: Hjersonin ampumisen jälkeen syyllisen jahti kiihtyy. Åkermanin perheen kulissi alkaa rakoilla. Tapauksesta tulee Hjersonille hyvin henkilökohtainen. Moderni ruotsalainen arvoitusdekkari, jonka innoittajina olivat Agatha Christien kertomukset. Ainutlaatuinen murhatutkija Sven Hjerson (Johan Rheborg) muodostaa yllättävän etsiväkaksikon omapäisen tv-tuottajan (Hanna Alström) kanssa. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Thomas kosiskelee Lilyä, vaikkei ole vielä eronnut. Trivial Pursuit saa Klaran ja Rillen päättämään rehellisistä väleistä, ja seuraukset ovat veriset. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2015

programme.title: Happy fucking Pride
programme.desc: “Load More Guys”. Dilan, Ari ja Nina tapaavat yön tapahtumien jälkeen ja joutuvat rajuun riitaan. Dilan yrittää saada Arin luottamaan itseensä mutta valehtelee taas. Tukholma kuplii odotuksia Pride-viikon alkaessa. Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Oliver pakottaa Jennyn siivomaamaan Jörgenin kämpän - muuten hän paljastaa Jennyn salaisuuden. Saga kutsuu Jennyn piknikille, mutta jokin on pielessä. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias
programme.desc: Sarja alkaa. Tobias pääsee vankilasta ja Morran siistii paikat, mutta Tobias kaipaa selliään. Hän lukkiutuu huoneeseensa ja sahaa oveen ruokaluukun. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Morranista ja tämän aikuisesta pojasta Tobiasista, jotka asuvat yhdessä ränsistyneessä talossa. Morran on saanut huomattavan tuen talon saneeraamiseen, mutta alituinen verkossa shoppailu näyttää aina olevan etusijalla. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Hotel Swan Helsinki
programme.desc: Rautala. Jessican puhelin antaa elonmerkkejä. Entä kuka on mystinen turvakamerassa näkyvä hahmo, jonka kanssa Jessica oli tekemisissä katoamisiltanaan? Luksushotellimaailmaan sijoittuvassa kotimaisessa draamasarjassa seurataan hotellijohtoa ja -henkilökuntaa murhatutkinnan keskiössä, jossa kaikilla tuntuu olevan jotain salattavaa. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Sininen enkeli
programme.desc: Irti menneisyydestä, kohti tulevaisuutta. Marko kohtaa tragedian. Kosto elää Puumalassa, Outin mustasukkaisuus nostaa päätään ja isäehdokkaita vierailee sairaalassa. MTV-alkuperäissarja Sininen enkeli kuvaa elävästi 1980-luvun värikästä nousukautta Helsingissä, jossa raha kasvaa puissa, avoautot takaavat vauhdin huuman ja solarium on uusi aurinko. Kaupunkiin saapuu maalaistaustaansa piilotteleva Marko Hyyryläinen, joka haluaa oman osansa rahasta ja rakkaudesta. Ohjelma sisältää syrjivää kielenkäyttöä. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Metsästäjät
programme.desc: Richardsson tekee läpimurron tutkinnassa muttei saa kertoa Erikille. Peter ja Erik yrittävät taas sopia, mutta vahvat tunteet tutkinnasta estävät sen. Ruotsalainen jännitysdraama, jossa Rolf Lassgård esittää omapäistä poliisia Erik Bäckströmiä. Sarja on jatkoa samannimiselle elokuvasarjalle. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: We Come in Peace
programme.desc: Valtapeliä. Moni seikka viittaa siihen, että taivaalla oleva ilmiö on yhteydessä lapsiin. Olisivatko he avain olentojen ymmärtämiseen? Aktivistien vihamielisyys lisääntyy, ja Moaa uhkaa epäluottamuslause. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Bäckström
programme.desc: Erikssonin murha näyttää hankalalta ratkaista, varsinkin kun Bäckström suljetaan pois tutkinnasta ja Ankanin on otettava ohjat käsiinsä. Ruotsalainen rikosdraama perustuu Leif G.W. Perssonin suosittuihin kirjoihin ristiriitaisesta ja omahyväisestä murhatutkijasta Evert Bäckströmistä, joka ratkoo rikoksia omintakeisella tyylillään. Ruotsi 2020

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Tiimi metsästää huumeriippuvaista Nancy Albrightia, joka etsii uutta tapaa päästä pilveen. Ajojahdin lomassa Bexin tiimin on pakko kohdata yllättävä tosiasia, että kaikkiin komentokeskuksessa ei voikaan luottaa. Yhdysvallat 2025

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: James Harper on entinen erikoisjoukkojen sotilas, joka armeijasta erotuksen jälkeen värväytyy puolustusalan yritykseen suorittamaan salaisia operaatioita puolustusministeriölle. Hän saa tehtäväkseen tarkkailla Lähi-idästä kotoisin olevaa tutkijaa Saksassa. Chris Pinen tähdittämä toimintatrilleri on ruotsalaisohjaaja Tarik Salehin (The Nile Hilton Incident) ensimmäinen englanninkielinen elokuva.

programme.title: Greenland
programme.desc: Katastrofi-toimintatrilleri, jossa maapalloon uhkaa iskeä komeetta. Atlantassa tapaamme insinööri John Garryn, joka yhdessä vaimonsa Allisonin ja poikansa Nathanin kanssa kamppailee paetakseen ja jäädäkseen eloon nähdessään tulevan tuhon laajuuden.

programme.title: Beck: Tuhkattu
programme.desc: Beck-ryhmä saa tutkittavakseen tapauksen, jossa pastori on kuollut Helluntaikirkon mailla tapahtuneessa tuhopoltossa. Rikospaikalle saapuvalle Alexille tapauksesta tulee henkilökohtainen, kun hän tapaa henkilön menneisyydestään. Avuksi rikostutkintaan Alex värvää mentorinsa Martin Beckin.

programme.title: Vingar av glas
programme.desc: Nazli on syntynyt Irakissa ja varttunut Ruotsissa. Hän haluaa sulautua yhteiskuntaan ja kutsuu itseään Saraksi, mikä surettaa hänen isäänsä, joka haluaa hänet naimisiin irakilaisen kanssa. Pian Sara tapaa Johanin, mikä ei helpota tilannetta.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Finale
programme.desc: Allt ska avgöras den sista träningskvällen. Ikväll går drömmar i uppfyllelse, eller i kras. Kelli överraskar tjejerna genom att ta med dem till lagets träningsplan, för att se dem prestera.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Preliminary Auditions

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Training Camp
programme.desc: Träningslägret börjar och många av de nya kandidaterna har behövt bryta upp och flytta till Dallas utan garanti för att de klarar lägret och blir en Dallas Cowboy Cheerleader .

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Jump Split
programme.desc: Det är bara andra repetitionsveckan och Kelli och Judy är snabba med att gå igenom DCC-rörelserna med kandidaterna. Många av de nya kandidaterna har aldrig gjort ett spagathopp och deras brist på erfarenhet gör att några av flickorna skadar sig.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeover

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Week Five
programme.desc: Det är femte träningsveckan och Kelli är borta på grund av sjukdom. DCC:s tekniska ledare, Kitty Carter, hoppar in och leder veckans första repetition. Kitty är brutalt ärlig när hon påpekar att flera av tjejerna dansar slarvigt.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Final Cuts
programme.desc: Träningslägrets sjunde vecka börjar med en repetition på planen på Cowboys Stadium. Kelli och Judy är redo att göra de sista uttagningarna och kvällens repetition kan avgöra vilka som går vidare till truppen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Announcing the Squad
programme.desc: Det är dags att tillkännage DCC-truppen men först ser Kelli och Judy till att det blir en sista repetition ute på plan på Cowboys Stadium för kandidaterna. Tjejerna känner av pressen och Kelli och Judy har koll på dem.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: High Performance
programme.desc: Truppen har lagt sitt första matchdagframträdande bakom sig, men efter ett dåligt rep hotar Kelli med att hon kommer att skicka hem de som inte ger 110 procent.

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 304

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 305
